precedents.product_name: Norelgestromin and Ethinyl Estradiol Transdermal System, 150/35 mcg per day
precedents.deficiency_text: 1. We acknowledge that your specifications for ethinyl estradiol and norelgestromin (specification nos. 01-1579-01 and 01-1459-03, respectively) direct use of the relevant current USP monograph methods. However, procedures outlined in the USP monographs and general chapters do not include sufficient detail to ensure that the testing is consistently or adequately performed with your samples at your facility. Revise Modules 3.2.S.4 of your application to include standard testing procedures for all tests listed in the drug substance specifications.

3. We acknowledge your submission of data for the system suitability test for
resolution between impurity J and the drug substance. We however note that
there is not adequate resolution between impurities H, F and A. Perform the revalidation
of system suitability and demonstrate that there is adequate resolution between these impurities or alternatively, improve on your analytical method for
adequate resolution.

9. We acknowledge that you proposed an in-process test for Drug content homogeneity in the Scotchpak 9723 and Celgard laminates. We recommend that you establish a sampling plan and statistical test-based acceptance criteria which includes the confidence level (e.g., 90%) and coverage (e.g., 95%) to pass USP <905> based on standards such as ASTM E2709/E2810 for content uniformity of in-process samples (e.g., collected during the coating/ drying/ laminating or converting process). You may provide additional justifications to support your sampling plan to support the proposed statistical in-process control. Update relevant documents including section 3.2.P.3.4 accordingly.
